contents.detail: The minmod formula and smooth-region face accuracy are stated and proved locally.

contents.name: §3.3: fully discrete MUSCL monotonicity and its CFL bound (equation 3.3.8)
contents.detail: For positive linear advection the source bound is 3/2 times the CFL at most one; the local exact tent data independently refute the assigned direct-update CFL-one assertion. No replacement theorem is claimed.

contents.name: §3.3: Burgers/Godunov shock-capturing examples
contents.detail: The source supplies the MUSCL/Godunov setup; the local example computes the Riemann flux, exact shock trace, entropy jump and first finite update.

contents.name: §3.3, equation (3.3.8): fully discrete minmod MUSCL monotonicity restriction
contents.detail: For positive linear advection, substituting the flux Lipschitz constants into (3.3.8) gives 3mu/2<=1. The theorem proves the total-variation estimate directly, handles negative velocity by reflection, and proves sharpness locally; the source supplies context rather than the local sharpness argument.

coverage.claim: Uniform-grid finite-volume cell averages, minmod MUSCL traces, separate nodal ENO2 and cell-average WENO5-JS/WENO-Z definitions, with systems characteristic reconstruction explicitly scoped.
Nodal ENO2 tie-left selector, well-defined quadratic and third-order face error.
WENO5 ideal weights, quartic moments and fifth-order optimal linear face estimate.
Second-order MUSCL/minmod face accuracy on smooth strictly monotone data where both one-sided differences share sign.
The planned direct MUSCL/minmod forward-Euler flux update is TVD for all CFL numbers up to one.
coverage.detail: The old universal claim is refuted by cex-na-musc-minmod-forward-euler-not-tvd-at-cfl-one; the new local theorem proves the sharp 2/3 bound and failure throughout 2/3<mu<=1.

coverage.claim: The unchanged direct forward-Euler MUSCL/minmod update is TVD for bi-infinite finite-variation or periodic data under the sharp bound |a|Delta t/h<=2/3, and fails for every larger CFL number through one.
Fixed positive epsilon WENO-JS and WENO-Z fifth-order finite-volume face reconstruction.
Scalar linear monotone one-step order barrier at noninteger Courant number.
Smooth affine advection, quadratic extremum clipping, Burgers entropy shock, WENO epsilon-scaling critical point, and an unlimited-centered-slope overshoot.
